text:
mara: Heads up — compliance flagged a few SSO sessions that mapped to admin unexpectedly for tenant_b. Not blanket, but reproducible pattern.
kevin: Which IdP and flow? Okta/AAD/SAML/OIDC?
mara: AAD -> our SAML bridge. Sample from audit: 
```nSAML_ATTR: roles="\"[\\\"read\\\",\\\"admin\\\"]\"", subject: user|extid:9876, key_meta: kms/claims
```
mara: Looks like roles arrived double-quoted/escaped so our normalizer split it into tokens and granted admin.
olga: We shipped claim_normalizer.v2 last week to handle legacy providers (strip quotes & coerce). Might be overzealous on quoted JSON arrays.
kevin: Any recent infra ops? KMS rotates/rewraps can introduce extra string layers if envelope payload was already escaped.
infra-bot: kms-rewrap: key_alias=kms/claims performed at 1712595100 by infra-ops (job id 7932).
deploy-bot: deploy: svc-auth@release-2024.11 rolled at 1712601000 by kevin.
mara: Correlates. Repro in staging: pre-kms assertion: roles=[\"read\",\"admin\"] -> after wrap parser sees roles="\"[\\\"read\\\",\\\"admin\\\"]\"" and splits on comma -> gets admin.
kevin: Ok mitigation: disable automatic coercion to list for that tenant and treat anything starting with '[' as JSON array to json.parse. Quick config change to map_admin=false for idp:tenant_b?
sam: +1 do config canary to prod-safe-1. Also add an alert rule for unexpected admin grants.
mara: Running audit query to check admin ops between 1712580000-1712660000: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" "https://audit-api.internal/query?since=1712580000&until=1712660000&filter=role:admin"
```
mara: Results: 3 events found — all read/list/profile calls, no destructive ops. Low blast but still needs full review.
olga: Short-term patch: claim-normalizer should detect JSON-array-like string (regex /^\s*\[.*\]\s*$/) and JSON.parse before splitting. I'll draft PR. Also add unit + e2e with KMS-wrapped payload.
kevin: I'll push the config toggle now. Can someone scope alert rule?
sam: infra-bot: created alert rbac_role_unexpected -> severity: high -> notify: security-oncall at 1712667905.
deploy-bot: started canary: svc-auth config toggle -> prod-safe-1 at 1712668000.
mara: Monitoring 15m. So far no new admin maps. :thumbsup:
olga: Follow-ups: PR for parser fix, tests, update SCIM docs to mention JSON-in-attr behavior, expand runbook to cover KMS rewrap correlates. Assign vuln-triage after audit scan.
kevin: Also audit any ROLE_CHANGE events with external IPs or scripted patterns. I'll run a wider scan.
mara: Filed incident INC-4601 and linked audit export. Will add timeline after full postmortem. Leaving thread open for vuln-triage notes.
